title: AI-Based Clinical Rule Discovery for NMIBC Recurrence through Tsetlin Machines
new_feature: Applies a vanilla TM to predict 3-year recurrence of non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer from tabular clinical data (PHOTO trial), with per-patient clause-activation heatmaps and clause-importance ranking for clinical rule discovery.

datasets.input_shape_or_features: clinical features (tumour count, hospital stay, EQ-5D score, smoking status, surgeon grade, ...); exact count not stated
datasets.split_as_reported: 80:20 stratified train:test split of 330 patients (40% recurrence) (~264/66, not stated)
datasets.booleanization: continuous features discretised at clinically meaningful cut-offs and thermometer-encoded; categoricals one-hot; Optuna tuned n_bins
datasets.notes: Private clinical trial data (PHOTO trial, 22 UK NHS centres; 539 patients, 330 after exclusions); not public. Endpoint: recurrence within 3 years of TURBT.

results.config: 80 clauses, T=38, s=4.0, 100 epochs (Optuna-tuned, 50 TPE trials)
